name: language-selector
purpose: Locale dropdown — an uppercase trigger with a small caret that opens a navy gradient list of locale codes on focus, with keyboard navigation; used to switch the UI language.

props.name: languages
props.description: Locale codes to offer (e.g. ['en', 'de', 'es', 'fr']). Must be a non-empty array of strings; a single entry renders the trigger without arrow or list.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected locale, compatible with Vue 2 v-model (pairs with the 'input' emit). Defaults to the first entry of languages; values not in the list are ignored.

notes: Sample state: closed, languages [en, de, es, fr, nl, pt], selected 'en' (renders EN via text-transform uppercase). Closed means the .list element is NOT in the DOM (upstream v-if) — the trigger arrow's closed orientation is driven by the :not(:where(:hover, :focus-within, :has(.list))) rule, so the HTML snippet also creates/removes the list dynamically instead of toggling visibility. Open state: navy .list (--nimiq-blue-bg bottom-right radial) overlays the trigger from bottom:-2rem, entries at opacity .4 that go full plus a white arrow on focus; the list opens on focus (focusin), closes on blur with upstream's 50ms delay so focus can move between entries, arrow keys wrap, Enter/Space select, Escape/Left close. The tabindex is removed while open, like upstream's :tabindex binding. The snippet fires an 'input' CustomEvent (detail = locale code) as the plain-HTML equivalent of the Vue emit. Not carried into the snippet: the .transition-fade opacity animation on open/close (entries appear without fade; noted, cosmetic only). Vue 3 port trap: upstream's Vue 2 '.transition-fade-enter' class is renamed '-enter-from'. Truth/demo pages carry 240px top headroom because the list opens upward; the selector crop is unaffected.
